name: g01_customer_count
question: كم عدد الزبائن؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM t.Customers

name: g02_salespersons
question: كم عدد المناديب؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM t.SalesPersons

name: g03_net_sales_july2025
question: صافي مبيعات يوليو 2025؟
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(td.Quantity * td.Price) AS gross_amount FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th INNER JOIN t.TransactionsDetails td ON th.CompanyID = td.CompanyID AND th.TransactionTypeID = td.TransactionTypeID AND th.TransactionYear = td.TransactionYear AND th.TransactionNo = td.TransactionNo WHERE th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0 AND th.TransactionDate >= '2025-07-01' AND th.TransactionDate <= '2025-07-31'

name: g04_invoice_headers_2025
question: كم فاتورة بيع غير ملغاة في سنة 2025؟
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT th.TransactionNo) AS n FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th WHERE th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0 AND th.TransactionDate >= '2025-01-01' AND th.TransactionDate <= '2025-12-31'
